turns.text: Hey, what's up? How are you doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're planning a cycling day trip and I can't decide on the route.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll go through the options one by one. Don't say anything until I finish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One route follows the coast, about thirty miles, flat, with a nice cafe at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one goes up through the vineyards, shorter, but with two pretty steep climbs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The third is a forest trail, mostly gravel, quiet and shady, maybe twenty miles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, that's all of them. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The coast route is the easiest and the cafe makes a great finish. The vineyard route has the best views, but those climbs could wear out a mixed group. The forest trail is lovely on a hot day, as long as everyone's bike can handle gravel.
